page_title: FRE 3-3 MON | Freiburg v B. Monchengladbach 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' 3 - 3 Goal! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Moritz Nicolas.
90+6' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+6' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Freiburg!
90+5' Celebrations by Freiburg are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
90+4' PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Freiburg.
90+2' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball.

90+1' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90+1' The foul by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Felix Brych.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
89' Freiburg string together a series of short passes.
87' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

86' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) meets a cross and produces a header towards the right side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
86' The referee awards a corner and Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take it.
83' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
82' The resulting corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) comes to nothing.
81' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and made an astonishing save!
81' That's the end of the game for Franck Honorat, who is replaced by Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Here is a change. Luca Netz is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Felix Brych didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
77' Surely that's handball by one of the B. Monchengladbach players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
77' The corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is intercepted by the defence.

76' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort.
76' The current number of shots on goal is 5:5.
72' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Felix Brych who sees an offensive foul. Freiburg have a free kick.
71' Nathan Ngoumou will be replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
71' Substitution. Alassane Plea makes way for Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
70' 2 - 3 Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets under the crossbar.
68' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes a short corner kick.

65' Superb touch by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) as he receives a precise pass into the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot towards the top right corner. Wonderful save! B. Monchengladbach have a corner.

64' That was a nice football moment. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Moritz Nicolas guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
61' The cross into the penalty area from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
59' Substitution. Ritsu Doan did his best and is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
59' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) replaces Merlin Rohl.
58' A lofted cross from Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
56' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
53' The referee blows his whistle as Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach in a dangerous position.

52' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Freiburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
50' Today's referee Felix Brych rightly decides to book Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) for his harsh tackle.
49' Looks like Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' Half-time substitution. Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) will not participate anymore and Jordy Makengo is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
45+5' Freiburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Jordan Siebatcheu is being substituted because of an injury. Gerardo Seoane sends Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) on the pitch.
40' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
39' 1 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Noah Atubolu no chance!
39' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
38' Wait! The referee has seen an infringement and B. Monchengladbach will have to take the penalty again!

37' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up sends the ball to the left side of the target, but Noah Atubolu keeps his cool to thwart him.
37' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is going to take the penalty!
37' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) sees a yellow card from Felix Brych after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
36' It’s a PENALTY to B. Monchengladbach after the VAR review!
36' Referee Felix Brych makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for B. Monchengladbach. Let’s see what happens!
36' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
31' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

29' 1 - 2 Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Noah Atubolu is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:2.
28' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
25' 1 - 1 GOAL! Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) scores with a header from close range after Luca Netz headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:1.
24' A clumsy foul by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) and Felix Brych blows his whistle. Free kick. B. Monchengladbach will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

23' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
20' It looks like Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Felix Brych won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.
17' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
16' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
10' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
7' 1 - 0 Lucas Holer (Freiburg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!

7' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball low towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Moritz Nicolas with a fabulous save.
6' Corner kick. Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
4' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) serves up a nice cross, but Moritz Nicolas punches the ball away.
2' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

2' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball is out of play. Freiburg win a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Felix Brych.
